title: Adversarial Scrubbing of Demographic Information for Text Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the predictability of the gender of the author or subject from intermediate text representations using probing networks, measuring F1-score and Minimum Description Length (MDL) on dialogue, tweet, and biography datasets.

Evaluating whether the race of the author (e.g., non-Hispanic blacks vs. whites) can be predicted from intermediate text representations using probing networks, measuring F1-score and Minimum Description Length (MDL) on the DIAL tweet dataset.
Measuring the predictability of the author's age from intermediate text representations using probing networks, assessed via F1-score and Minimum Description Length (MDL) on the PAN16 tweet dataset.
